name: Microsoft 365 Education (Office 365 A1)
summary: Free web versions of Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and OneNote with an eligible uni email.
key: Free with an eligible education email.
numbers: Web versions of Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and OneNote, plus Publisher and Access on PC
Full desktop apps, which come with the A3 plan
how: Select Get started for students on Microsoft's education page.
Verification is often instant, but can take up to a month.
catches: Your uni may already give you the full desktop apps through its own licence. Check with your uni IT service first.
If the plan ends you can still view your files but not edit them.
